title: Coordination of volunteer support and integration structures
summary: Practical experience in organising and coordinating volunteer support services related to integration, education and social participation.

text: Practical experience in organising and coordinating volunteer support services related to integration, education and social participation.
The focus is on structuring tasks, coordinating the people involved and developing supporting organisational processes.
Practical coordination: structuring tasks, coordinating between the people involved and setting up supporting organisational processes in the voluntary sector.
